title: CI Run Evidence v1
description: Canonical CI run evidence produced by the CI evidence orchestrator. Captures runner context, git metadata, workflow information, release classification, and pointers to related evidence artifacts.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this CI run. For GitHub Actions: run_id. For local: timestamp-based UUID.

run_attempt.description: Run attempt number. Defaults to 1 for first attempt.

official_release.description: True only for GitHub Actions runs triggered by a release event against a protected branch. False for all other cases including Codespaces and local execution.

release_class.description: Release classification derived from runner/event/ref context.

git_branch.description: Git branch at CI run time.

git_sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA at CI run time.

git_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at CI run time.

workflow_name.description: Workflow name from GitHub Actions context. Empty for local runs.

workflow_ref.description: Workflow ref from GitHub Actions context (e.g., org/repo/.github/workflows/ci.yml@ref). Empty for local runs.

workflow_sha.description: Commit SHA of the workflow file. Empty if not determinable.

job_name.description: Current job name from the CI environment. Empty for local runs.

event_name.description: GitHub event name that triggered the workflow (push, pull_request, release, etc.). Empty for local runs.

actor.description: Human-readable actor classification (github username or 'local-user'). Never includes secrets or tokens.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of CI run start.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of CI run completion. Omitted if still running.

artifact_index_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the artifact index JSON for this run.

verdict_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the CI verdict JSON for this run.

evidence_event_stream_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the evidence event stream JSONL for this run.

telemetry_redaction_notes.description: Statement that no raw secrets, credentials, private file contents, raw prompts, or private repository contents were emitted in this evidence.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence record was generated.

trace_id.description: Optional distributed trace identifier for joinability across surfaces.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier linking related CI runs or provider operations.
